title: THE FIRST 10 MINUTES OF YOUR MORNING CAN CHANGE EVERYTHING
text: Glory, glory, glory to the most high God. Somebody lift your voice right where you are and begin to bless the name of the Lord. Begin to magnify the King of Kings. Begin to exalt the one who sits on the throne. For he alone is worthy. He alone is deserving. He alone is the reason we are gathered. Oh, I sense something in the atmosphere already. There is a staring. There is a moving. There is a shifting. The spirit of the living God is present in this place. And I want you to know that what is about to happen in this service is not ordinary. This is not religious programming. This is not spiritual entertainment. This is a divine orchestration. Heaven has arranged this moment. Heaven has prepared this encounter. Heaven has scheduled this visitation. And you are not here by accident. You are not listening by coincidence. The hand of God has guided you to this very moment because there is something he wants to release into your life. Hallelujah. Before we go any further, I want you to do something. I want you to share this message. Send it to someone right now. Post it, forward it, let it go out. Because you may be the bridge through which someone's miracle crosses over. You may be the instrument through which someone's breakthrough is delivered. You may be the vessel through which someone's destiny is unlocked. The Bible says we are laborers together with God. And one of the ways we labor is by spreading the word. So don't keep this to yourself. Let it multiply. Let it spread. Let it reach the nations. Now I want us to enter into worship but not ordinary worship. I want us to worship with intention. I want us to worship with revelation. I want us to worship with the understanding that we are approaching the throne of grace. Hebrews 4:16 says, "Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace that we may obtain mercy and find grace to help in time of need." We are coming boldly. We are coming confidently. We are coming expectantly because there is grace at the throne. There is mercy at the throne. There is [music] help at the throne. So lift your voice and worship. Father, we worship you. We worship you Lord. You are holy. You are righteous. You are faithful. You are true. There is none like you in all the earth. There is none beside you in all the heavens. You are the unccreated one. You are the self-existent one. You are the allsufficient one. And we bow before your majesty. We bow before your glory. We bow before your sovereignty. Hallelujah. Robboandila Shababa Shandai. Yes Lord, we worship you. You are the God who opens doors. You are the God who makes ways. You are the God who breaks barriers. You are the God who removes limitations. And we worship you. We worship you. We worship you singing in the spirit. Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty who was and is and is to come. Heaven and earth are full of your glory. Hosana in the highest. Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord. We worship you father. We worship you son. We worship you holy spirit. Three in one. One in three. The eternal godhead. The trinity divine. We worship you shababa komos shandai robbo chandela secondhai. Now, I want to share something with you that I believe has the power to revolutionize your life. And I'm not exaggerating. I'm not using hyperbole. I mean exactly what I'm saying. What I'm about to share with you can revolutionize your life if you receive it with faith and act on it with consistency. The title of what we're dealing with today is this. The first 10 minutes of your morning can change everything. I want you to write that down. Meditate on it. Let it sink into your spirit. The first 10 minutes, not the first hour, not the first 30 minutes, the first 10 minutes. Why 10 minutes? Because 10 minutes is not overwhelming. 10 minutes is achievable. 10 minutes is sustainable. Anyone can give God 10 minutes. The busiest person in the world has 10 minutes. The most overwhelmed, most stressed, most occupied person can find 10 minutes. But here's the revelation. Those 10 minutes when invested correctly have the power to change everything. Not some things, everything. Let me give you scripture. Go with me to Psalm 5:es 1-3. David says, "Give ear to my words, oh Lord. Consider my meditation. Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my king and my God. For unto thee will I pray. [music] My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, oh Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer onto thee and will look up. Did you see that? David said, "My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, not in the afternoon when he felt like it. Not in the evening when he had time, in the morning as a priority, as a discipline, as a covenant." And then he said, "In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee." The word [music] direct is powerful. In the Hebrew it is arak. It means to set in order, to arrange, to prepare, to lay out systematically. David is saying, Lord, in the morning, I don't just wake up and mumble some religious words. I don't just go through the motions. I direct my prayer. I arrange my petitions. I set my requests in order before you. This is intentional prayer. This is strategic engagement. This is purposeful communion. And then he says, "And we look up." After directing his prayer, David watches. He expects, he anticipates because he knows that when he engages heaven in the morning, heaven responds. Hallelujah. Now, let me give you another dimension. The title also says, "Pray this early morning prayer that opens impossible doors before breakfast." Did you catch that? before breakfast, before you feed your body, you must feed your spirit, before you nourish your flesh, you must nourish your soul. Before you take care of the temporal, you must attend to the eternal. Jesus said in Matthew 4:4, "Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeded out of the mouth of God." Every word, not some words, every word. And where do you get the word? In the morning, in the place of prayer, in the secret place of the most high, when you prioritize the word over bread, you are making a statement to heaven. You are saying, "Lord, I value you more than I value food. I value your presence more than I value physical nourishment. I value your direction more than I value my daily sustenance." And God honors that kind of priority. Let me tell you something. There are doors in your life that are impossible to open, not difficult. Impossible. Doors that human wisdom cannot unlock. Doors that money cannot purchase. Doors that connections cannot access. Doors that strategies cannot breach. Doors that effort cannot force open. Impossible doors. But the title says these doors can be opened. How? Through early morning prayer. Let me give you scripture in Isaiah 45:1. God says, "Thus sayaeth the Lord to his anointed to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holding to subdue nations before him, and I will loose the loins of kings to open before him the two lived gates, and the gates shall not be shut." Did you hear that? God said, "I will open before him the two lived gates, and the gates shall not be shut." When God opens a door, it stays open. When God opens a gate, no one can close it. When God makes a way, it is permanent. And verse two continues, I will go before thee and make the crooked places straight. I will break in pieces the gates of brass and cut in sunder the bars of iron. GATES OF BRASS. BARS OF IRON. This represent impossible barriers, unbreakable obstacles, immovable hindrances. But God said he will break them in pieces. He will cut them asunder. He will demolish them. This is what happens when you engage God in the first 10 minutes of your morning. This is what happens when you pray before breakfast. Impossible doors open. Gates of BRASS ARE BROKEN. BARS OF IRON ARE CUT in pieces. Hallelujah. Let me teach you something. In the realm of the spirit, there is a principle of first things. God is concerned about what comes first. What you prioritize reveals what you value. And what you value determines what you receive. In Matthew 6:33, Jesus said, "But seek ye first the kingdom of God and his righteousness, and all these things shall be added unto you. Seek ye first." Not second, not third, not last, first. When you seek God first in your morning, you are obeying a divine principle. You are aligning with a kingdom law. You are positioning yourself for supernatural addition. All these things shall be added onto you. What things? The things you need, the things you desire, the things you've been praying for, the things you've been believing for, they shall be added. Not subtracted, not divided, added, multiplied because you sought first the kingdom of God. Hallelujah. Now I want you to understand the warfare dimension of this. The enemy also understands the importance of the morning. He knows that whoever controls the morning controls the day. That's why he sends spirits of sleep and slumber. That's why he sends heaviness when your alarm goes off. That's why he gives you excuses to stay in bed. That's why he convinces you that you can pray later. The enemy is strategic. He's not playing games. He has a plan for your morning. And if you don't have a plan, his plan will prevail. But I've come to announce to you today, no more. The enemy's agenda for your morning is cancelled. The enemy's plan for your day is terminated. The enemy's strategy for your life is defeated. You will rise early. You will engage heaven. You will pray before breakfast. An impossible doors will open. Let me give you more scripture. In Mark 1:35, the Bible says, "And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out and departed into a solitary place and there prayed, "This is Jesus, the Son of God, the one who has all authority." And yet he rose up a great while before day. A great while before day. Not at dawn, not at sunrise, a [music] great while before day. If Jesus who was fully God prioritized early morning prayer, how much more should you and I prioritize it? If Jesus who had all power found it necessary to wake up before day, how can we say we are too busy? If Jesus who created the heavens and the earth, devoted himself to prayer before the day began, what excuse do we have? None. We have no excuse. And I prophesy to someone, the spirit of excuse is broken over your life. The spirit of laziness is broken. The spirit of procrastination is broken. You will rise. You will pray. You will engage. And you will see the impossible become possible. Hallelujah. Now, let me show you what happens in the first 10 minutes. When you wake up and immediately engage God, several things happen in the realm of the spirit. First you establish jurisdiction. When you pray in the morning, you are establishing spiritual jurisdiction over your day. You are declaring that this day belongs to God. You are announcing that heaven has authority over the next 24 hours. You are proclaiming that no weapon formed against you shall prosper. Psalm 35:3 says, "Say unto my soul, I am thy salvation." Notice David is speaking to his own soul. He's establishing jurisdiction over his inner man. He's not waiting for someone else to speak to him. He's speaking to himself in the morning. Speak to your soul. Tell your soul who is in charge. Tell your soul who is Lord. Tell your soul who has the final say. Establish jurisdiction. Second, you release angels. When you pray in the morning, you activate angelic assistance. Hebrews 1:14 says, "Are they not all ministering spirits? sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation. Angels are ministering spirits. They are sent to minister for us. But angels respond to the word of God. Psalm 103:20 says, "Bless the Lord, ye his angels that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word." Angels hearken unto the voice of his word. When you speak the word in the morning, angels hear it. When you declare the promises of God, angels respond. When you release scriptural decrees, angels are activated. In your first 10 minutes, you can release more angelic activity than most people release in a month because you are giving voice to the word. Third, you disarm the enemy. When you pray in the morning, you preemptively strike the enemy's plans. You are not waiting for the attack to come. You are attacking before the attack. You are striking before the strike. You are waring before the war. This is the principle of preemptive warfare. Don't wait for the enemy to ambush you. Ambush him first. Don't wait for the day to bring problems. Address the problems before they arise. Don't wait for battles to find you. Go find the battles and win them in the spirit. Hallelujah. Fourth, you download divine strategy. When you pray in the morning, you receive wisdom for the day. You receive direction for your decisions. You receive insight for your challenges. You receive revelation for your assignments. James 1:5 says, "If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God that giveth to all men liberally and upgrade not. And it shall be given him. If you lack wisdom, ask of God, he gives liberally without finding fault, and it shall be given." In your first 10 minutes, you can receive wisdom that will save you years of mistakes. You can receive direction that will prevent costly detours. You can receive insight that will unlock opportunities. You can receive revelation that will transform your trajectory. Don't start your day without downloading from heaven. Fifth, you prophesy your day into existence. When you pray in the morning, you are speaking your day before it happens. You are calling those things that are not as though they were. You are framing your experiences with words of faith. Proverbs 18:21 says, "Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof." Death and life in the power of your tongue, and you will eat the fruit. What fruit are you planting in the morning? What words are you speaking? What declarations are you making? Because whatever you speak is what you will experience [music] in your first 10 minutes. You can speak a day of victory into existence. You can speak a day of favor into being. You can speak a day of breakthrough into manifestation. Don't leave your DAY TO CHANCE. PROPHESY IT INTO EXISTENCE. HALLELUJAH. NOW, I want to show you a powerful scripture. Go with me to Lamentations 3 22- 23. The Bible says, "It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed because his compassions fail not. [music] They are new every morning. Great is thy faithfulness. Did you hear that? New every morning. God's mercies are new every morning. God's compassions are new every morning. His faithfulness is demonstrated every morning. This means that every morning there is a fresh supply, a new batch, a current release of mercy, of compassion, of faithfulness. But here's the question. Are you accessing it? The mess is available, but are you collecting them? The compassions are released, but are you receiving them? The faithfulness is demonstrated, but are you experiencing it? In your first 10 minutes, you can access the fresh supply of heaven. You can collect the new mercies. You can receive the morning compassions. You can experience the demonstrated faithfulness. Don't let the day go by without accessing what heaven has made available. >> Hallelujah. Let me give you another dimension. In Exodus chapter 16, when God provided mana for the children of Israel, he gave them specific instructions. In verse 21, the Bible says, "And they gathered it every morning, every man according to his eating. And when the sun waxed hot, it melted. They gathered it every morning." Not whenever they felt like it. Every morning. And notice what happened when they delayed. When the sun waxed hot, it melted. The mana was no longer available. The provision that was accessible in the morning was gone by midday. There are blessings that are available in the morning that will not be available later. There are doors that are open in the morning that will close by afternoon. There are opportunities that are present in the morning that will pass by evening. This is why the enemy fights your morning. He knows that if he can keep you from the morning encounter, he can keep you from the morning supply. But I decree over your life, you will not miss your morning gathering. You will not oversleep your divine appointment. You will not be late to your heavenly encounter. You will rise early. You will collect your mana. You will access your supply. Shababa baba. Colomos shandai robo chandela. Hallelujah. Now the title mentions impossible doors. Let me teach you about these doors. An impossible door is a door that cannot be opened by natural means. It is a door that defies human logic. It is a door that mocks natural effort. It is a door that stands as a testimony to the limitations of men. But here's the revelation. Every impossible door has a key. And that key is found in the presence of God. In Revelation 3:7, the Bible says, "And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia, write these things saith he that is holy, he that is true, he that had the key of David. He that openeth and no man shutth and shutth and no man openeth. He that had the key of David, he that openeth and no man shutth. He that shutth and no man openeth." Jesus has the key. the key of David. And when he opens, no one can shut. When he shuts, no one can open. [music] In your first 10 minutes, you can access the one who has the key. You [music] can connect with the one who opens impossible doors. You can encounter the one who has authority over every barrier. This is why early morning prayer is so powerful. You are not just talking to the air. You are not just performing a religious ritual. You are accessing the one who holds the keys. Hallelujah. >> [music] >> Let me tell you about some impossible doors that can open when you pray in the morning. The door of favor. There is a door of favor that can open over your life. A door that causes people to look at you with kindness. A door that makes strangers want to help you. A door that positions you for promotion without politics. Psalm 5:12 says, "For thou Lord will bless the righteous. With favor will thou compass him as with a shield. Favor like a shield surrounding you, protecting you, going before you. In your first 10 minutes, you can decree favor over your day and the door of favor will open. People who were supposed to ignore you will notice you. Opportunities that were supposed to pass you by will find you. Positions that were supposed to go to others will come to you. [music] The door of provision. There is a door of provision that can open over your life. A door that releases resources for your assignment. A door that funds your vision. A door that supplies your needs. Malachi 3:10 says, "Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now herewith, sayeth the Lord of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing that there shall not be room enough to receive it." The windows of heaven poured out blessings. Not enough room to receive. In your first 10 minutes, you can decree provision over your day. And the door of provision will open. Money will come to you from unexpected sources. Contracts will be signed in your favor. Debts will be supernaturally canceled. Inheritance will be released. The door of healing. There is a door of healing that can open over your life. A door that brings restoration to your body. A door that brings wholeness to your mind. A door that brings wellness to your entire being. Malachi 4:2 says, "But unto you that fear my name shall the son of righteousness arise with healing in his wings, and ye shall go forth and grow up as calves of the stall." The son of righteousness arising with healing in his wings. And notice when he arises in the morning. The son arises in the morning. In your first 10 minutes, you can decree healing over your body. And the door of healing will open. Diseases will flee. Sicknesses will depart. Infirmities will be broken. You will walk in divine health. The door of deliverance. There is a door of deliverance that can open over your life. A door that brings freedom from bondage. A door that breaks the chains of addiction. A door that releases you from generational curses. Psalm 30:5 says, "For his anger endureth but a moment. In his favor is life. Weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning. Joy cometh in the morning. Deliverance arrives in the morning. Freedom breaks forth in the morning. In your first 10 minutes, you can [singing] decree deliverance over your life and the door of deliverance will open. Chains will fall off. Prisons will be unlocked. Captivity will be reversed. You will walk in glorious liberty. Hallelujah. Now I'm going to shift into prayer and I need everyone to stand to their feet. This is not a spectator moment. This is a participation moment. If you don't engage, you won't receive. If you don't participate, you won't partake. If you don't press in, you won't break through. So stand to your feet. Lift your hands. Open your mouth. And let's engage heaven together. Shababa komos shandai. Robo chandela. Yes Lord. Father, in the name of Jesus Christ, I come before your throne this morning. I come with boldness. I come with confidence. I come with holy audacity because you have given me access through the blood of your son. I declare that this morning is consecrated unto you. This morning belongs to the kingdom. This morning is under the authority of Jesus Christ. Now I want you to speak after me. Father, I dedicate the first 10 minutes of my morning to you. From this day forward, my morning belongs to you. Before breakfast, I will seek your face. Before I feed my body, I will feed my spirit. Before I attend to the natural, I will attend to the supernatural. Shaba baba. Say this. I decree that impossible doors are opening in my life. [music] Doors that no man can shut. Doors that defiance cannot close. Doors that resistance cannot block. I am walking through impossible doors. Say this. I command every door that the enemy has closed against me to open now. Career doors open. [music] Financial doors open. Relationship doors open. Ministry doors open. Academic doors open. Health doors open. Every door that should be open in my life, I command you to open now. Robocandela komoshandanda. I say this. I [music] break every lock that has been placed on my doors. I break every chain that has been wrapped around my gates. I break every seal that has been used to shut me out by the blood of Jesus. I break it now. Say this. I decree that favor surrounds me as a shield. [music] Everywhere I go today, favor goes with me. Everyone I meet today, favor speaks for me. Every situation I face today, favor works for me. Hallelujah. >> Now, let's pray over specific areas. Let's pray over your family. Father, in the name of Jesus, I cover my family with the blood of Jesus. I declare that my household is protected. I declare that my home is preserved. I declare re that no evil shall befall my dwelling. I speak salvation over every unsaved family member. I declare that they shall come to the knowledge of Christ. I declare that the God of Jacob shall become their God. I declare that the light of the world shall illuminate their darkness. I break every curse operating against my family. I break every generational pattern of failure. I break every ancestral covenant with darkness. I break every bloodline affliction. My family is free. My family is blessed. My family is favored. Shaba baba kom shandai. I pray for marriages in my family. I speak restoration to broken marriages. I speak reconciliation to separated couples. I speak love where there is hatred. I speak peace where there is strife. I speak faithfulness where there is unfaithfulness. I pray for children in my family. I speak protection over their lives. I speak destiny over their futures. I speak wisdom over their decisions. I speak purity over their relationships. I speak excellence over their academics. I pray for parents and elders in my family. I speak long life over them. I speak health over their bodies. I speak provision over their needs. I speak peace over their minds. I speak honor over their remaining years. Every impossible door that needs to open for my family, I command it to open now. Doors of breakthrough, doors of deliverance, doors of restoration, doors of blessing, open now in Jesus name. Robbo chandela shaba. Now let's pray over your finances. Father, in the name of Jesus, I speak over my finances. I declare that the blessing of Abraham is upon my leaf. E, I declare that I am blessed to be a blessing. I declare that wealth and riches are in my house. I break every cause of poverty. I break every spirit of lack. I [music] break every pattern of financial struggle. I break every cycle of debt. I break every limitation on my prosperity. I command the windows of heaven to open over my life. I command the floodgates of provision to be released. I command financial miracles to manifest. I command unexpected income to flow. I command supernatural multiplication to occur. I declare that money is a tool in my hands, not a master over my life. I declare that I am generous and rich. I declare that I finance the kingdom. I declare that I fund the gospel. I declare that I bless the nations. Every impossible door of financial breakthrough, I command it to open now. Doors of contracts, doors of opportunities, doors of investments, doors of inheritances, doors of divine settlements, open nowandela, I speak to your salary and I command it to increase. I speak to your business and I command it to prosper. I speak to your investments and I command them to multiply. I speak to your debts and I command them to be cancelled. Someone listening before this week ends, you will receive a financial testimony. Money you were not expecting will come to you. A deal you had given up on will be resurrected. A payment that was delayed will be released. A blessing that was blocked will break through. Receive it now. Hallelujah. Tend to me. I command the hours to work for me. Time is my servant, not my master. I decree divine acceleration. What was delayed is released now. What was stolen is restored now. What was lost is recovered now. Shaba shandai. Now hear me as I seal this prayer. I prophesy over your life. From this morning forward, everything changes. The first 10 minutes of your morning will never be wasted again. You will rise with purpose. You will PRAY WITH POWER. You will decree with authority. Impossible doors are swinging open as I speak. Doors of favor, doors of provision, doors of healing, doors of deliverance, doors of destiny. The siege is over. The warfare is finished. The victory is won. I decree that before this week runs out, your testimony will be loud. What has been delayed will manifest suddenly. What has been blocked will break through violently. What has been impossible will become your reality. Walk into this day with confidence. Walk into this week with authority. Walk into this season with expectation. Your morning is secured. Your day is blessed. Your future is preserved. The hand of God is upon you. The favor of God surrounds you. The angels of God accompany you. No weapon shall prosper. No cause shall stand. No enemy shall prevail. You are more than a conqueror. You are the head and not the tail. You are above and not beneath. You are blessed coming in and blessed going out. Robo Shandila Shababa Komos Shandai Second Deshai in the mighty matchless magnificent name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth. It is done. It is sealed. It is established. Heaven has witnessed. Earth has recorded. Hell has acknowledged. Your breakthrough is permanent. Your victory is [music] irreversible. Your testimony is guaranteed. Amen. Amen and amen. Hallelujah. Go forth in power. Share this message. Let it change someone else's life. And remember, the first 10 minutes of your morning can change everything. God bless you.
